decisions.label: Autopsy
decisions.description: A postmortem examination of the body that includes an examination of the internal organs and structures after dissection to determine the cause of death and the nature of pathological changes.

verification.note: NCIT:C25153 Autopsy; exact label match for the biospecimen acquisition method.

decisions.label: Biopsy Procedure
decisions.description: The removal of tissue specimens or fluid from the living body for microscopic examination, performed to establish a diagnosis.

verification.note: NCIT:C15189 Biopsy Procedure; label adds 'Procedure' but is the correct parent class for all biopsy acquisition methods.

decisions.label: Phlebotomy
decisions.description: The collection of blood from a vein, most commonly via needle venipuncture.

verification.note: NCIT:C28221 Phlebotomy; label differs (phlebotomy is the formal clinical term for blood draw) but the concept is equivalent.

decisions.label: Core Biopsy
decisions.description: The removal of a tissue sample using a needle with a relatively large diameter, for microscopic examination.

verification.note: NCIT:C15680 Core Biopsy; label omits 'needle' but the definition explicitly describes a needle-based procedure and is equivalent to 'core needle biopsy'.

decisions.label: Excisional Biopsy
decisions.description: A surgical procedure in which an entire lesion is removed for microscopic examination.

verification.note: NCIT:C15385 Excisional Biopsy; exact label match.

decisions.label: Fine-Needle Aspiration
decisions.description: The removal of tissue or fluid with a thin needle for examination under a microscope.

verification.note: NCIT:C15361 Fine-Needle Aspiration; label uses 'aspiration' vs 'aspirate' and hyphenates 'Fine-Needle', but the concept is identical.

decisions.label: Forceps Biopsy
decisions.description: The removal of a tissue sample using a specially-designed endoscope consisting of a slender flexible forceps with movable cup-shaped jaws.

verification.note: NCIT:C177206 Forceps Biopsy; exact label match.

decisions.label: Incisional Biopsy
decisions.description: A surgical procedure in which part of a lesion is removed for microscopic examination.

verification.note: NCIT:C15386 Incisional Biopsy; exact label match.

decisions.label: Lymphadenectomy
decisions.description: Surgical removal of lymph nodes, usually done to assess the spread of cancer.

verification.note: NCIT:C15275 Lymphadenectomy; label omits '(regional nodes)' qualifier but is the correct procedure class. The parenthetical specifies scope within the data model.

decisions.label: Not Applicable
decisions.description: Determination of a value is not relevant in the current context.

verification.note: NCIT:C48660 Not Applicable; standard NCIT qualifier, exact match.
NCIT:C43234 Not Reported; standard NCIT qualifier, exact match.

decisions.label: Pancreaticoduodenectomy
decisions.description: Surgical excision of all or part of the pancreas and duodenum.

decisions.label: Punch Biopsy
decisions.description: Removal of a disk of skin tissue, for microscopic examination, using a punch.

verification.note: NCIT:C28743 Punch Biopsy; exact label match (case-insensitive).

decisions.label: Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy
decisions.description: Surgical removal and examination of the sentinel node, the lymph node which is first in receiving the lymphatic drainage of a specified anatomic location and is most likely to be affected by the lymphatic spread of cancer.

verification.note: NCIT:C15667 Sentinel Lymph Node Biopsy; label expands 'node' to 'Lymph Node' but is the correct and only NCIT term for this procedure.

decisions.label: Shave Biopsy
decisions.description: Removal skin tissue, for microscopic examination, using a blade oriented in the horizontal plane of the skin surface.

verification.note: NCIT:C15387 Shave Biopsy; exact label match (case-insensitive).

decisions.label: Resection
decisions.description: The surgical removal of all or part of an organ or tissue structure that may include a lesion.

verification.note: NCIT:C158758 Resection; label drops 'Surgical' but is a surgical procedure by definition and is the best available NCIT match for surgical resection as a biospecimen acquisition method.

decisions.label: Unknown
decisions.description: Not known, observed, recorded, or reported as unknown by the data contributor.

verification.note: NCIT:C17998 Unknown; standard NCIT qualifier, exact match.
